scale.schedule_gate: Not recovered from the generic system adapters.

visibility.hidden_if: Native trim result is exactly the one-byte string 0.
visibility.flag_world_resource: hudFlag also updates a separate world flag resource.

persistence.format: tally <x> <y>\nbuild <x> <y>\n; only rows with stored Some(Vec2) are written.
persistence.read: Exactly three whitespace fields; exact tally/build key; both f32 values finite; later valid duplicates overwrite.
persistence.coordinates: Absolute top-left window-logical pixels before UiScale; persisted values are not normalized.
persistence.save_trigger: Release of an active drag; both saved positions are serialized.
persistence.load_lifetime: ScreensPlugin build at 0x14003fc40 calls 0x140272060 at 0x140042d1e. Its vtable build slot is +0x40 at 0x145d717b0, registered by 0x140063df0 and dispatched by Bevy add_plugin at 0x144dd2bfa. This is plugin/world setup; no per-run-entry reread is established.

drag.start: Changed Interaction::Pressed on a Movable and no active drag; no keyboard modifier test.
drag.pointer: In-bounds window cursor physical coordinates divided by window scale; otherwise Touches::iter().next().map(Touch::position), copied directly with no scaling or normalization.
drag.held: Left mouse pressed OR Touches pressed-map nonempty; release/save only when both are absent.
drag.placement: clamp(stored, 0, max(viewport - ComputedNode.size * inverse_scale_factor * UiScale, 0)) / UiScale

default_none.build: left = 10 / UiScale; top = 120 / UiScale; right = Auto
default_none.tally: left = Auto; top = 10 / UiScale; right = margin / UiScale
default_none.margin: 200 without a frame rectangle wider than one pixel; otherwise max(viewport_width - frame.left + 10, 10)
default_none.query: 0x140639a80 copies MinimapWidget's optional rendered rectangle in window-logical pixels; this is the rendered QuadContent::Minimap widget, independent of its FrameXML name.
default_none.update: Default offsets are reapplied each placement update, so they react to scale, resize and frame movement; None is not converted to Some.

touch_fallback.drag_binding: 0x140285ae0 uses getter 0x140028a40 and stores the ID at state+0x260; adapter 0x140285e80 passes that resource as argument 5 to drag-start 0x1402788c0.
touch_fallback.producer_binding: 0x144569c30 registers the identical GUID at 0x1468fd3a0 into state+8; adapter 0x144569e50 passes that ResMut to input producer 0x144562920.
touch_fallback.producer: The producer clears the three transient maps at +0x20/+0x40/+0x60, preserves previous position for the pressed map, reads touch-event phases, and stores event position directly. Its four-map phase behavior matches the version-bound Bevy source.
touch_fallback.selection: Only the currently pressed map at resource+0 is read. Native iterator 0x143608050 and drag 0x1402789d5 select its first full bucket, reading the last Vec2 of a 136-byte (u64,Touch) bucket. There is no pointer-ID, mouse-only, or window filter.
touch_fallback.coordinates: Touch::position is copied directly; the fallback adds no UiScale, scale-factor, or normalized-coordinate transform.
touch_fallback.release: 0x140275753 tests the pressed-map iterator if Left mouse is absent; empty releases/saves, nonempty continues the drag.
touch_fallback.limit: Platform event delivery and controlled live touch behavior were not executed.

frame_rectangle_producer.getter: 0x140639a80; tag bit 0 and rect at resource + 0x10
frame_rectangle_producer.init: 0x140c565ce uses the identical GUID at 0x145ef50c8; resource ID stored at system state + 0x270 by 0x140c568cc.
frame_rectangle_producer.adapter: 0x140c571d7 fetches state + 0x270, resolves resource data to rsp+0xc0, wraps it at rsp+0x1c0, and passes that ResMut at rsp+0x48 to 0x140bfa140.
frame_rectangle_producer.paint: 0x140bfa896 initializes a None slot; convert receives its address at 0x140bfba8f; 0x140bfc46d copies all 64 bytes into that resource.
frame_rectangle_producer.variant: Both native QuadContent switches use discriminant xor 0x8000000000000000. Variant 1 is formatted as Minimap at 0x140c76abd and converted at 0x140c024f2.
frame_rectangle_producer.conversion: The Minimap branch writes Some tag 1, window-logical y-down rect at +0x10, z at +0x20, alpha at +0x30, and zoom bytes at +0x34.
frame_rectangle_producer.static_limit: Generic ABI and jump-table omissions in raw Ghidra imports are resolved by the retained original assembly and hash-bound dispatch tables; frame scheduling remains unverified.

confirm.scope: Only buttons carrying native Confirm, including End Run; dispatch remains separate.

pause.input_limit: Field gates and native callbacks recovered; stock FrameXML GameMenu interception was not established.

limits: Static Ghidra and bounded original-instruction execution; the game was not launched.
Raw imports omit external data/callees and use generic ABI; assembly corroborates Windows arguments.
Native system schedule gating and all pointer/platform interactions need runtime comparison.
Shared constructor 0x140272060 is retained by the layout scope; no duplicate extract here.
